content: दाहः [दह्-भावे-घञ्] .²1 Burning, conflagration; दाहशक्तिमिव कृष्णवर्त्मनि <ls>R. 11. 42</ls>; छेदो दंशस्य दाहो वा <ls>M. 4. 4</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 14</ls>. .²2 Glowing redness (as of the sky). .²3 The sensation of burning, internal heat. .²4 Feverish or morbid heat. .²5 A place of cremation; <ls>Vās. 19. 26</ls>. .²6 Cauterizing; <ls>M. 4. 4</ls>.
दाह, दाहक, दाहन, दाह्य, <ab>&c.</ab>¦ See under दह्.
